work_summary: Implemented relia compile managed AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md marker blocks from active accepted memory rules.
Added idempotent marker replacement that fails closed on mismatched, duplicated, or out-of-order markers and preserves content outside the managed block.
Added offline init required-check discovery from .github/required-checks.json and compile target config validation.
Generated the repository managed block in AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and memory/compiled/agents-block.md.
Repaired Codex review feedback by resolving documented block-scalar rule statements before validation and compiled context rendering.
Supervisor repair after factoryd non-convergence made missing serve.compile settings fall back to defaults for upgraded repos.
Supervisor repair after factoryd non-convergence rejects Relia managed marker literals in rule statements before compiled block rendering.
Supervisor repair after latest-head Codex review accepts quoted serve.compile target scalars before enforcing allowed target names.
Supervisor repair after latest-head Codex review accepts inline serve.compile target lists before enforcing allowed target names.
Supervisor repair after latest-head Codex review filters workflow discovery to job-level check names instead of step names.
Supervisor repair after latest-head Codex review uses resolved block-scalar rule statements when serving assess/advise/serve rule data.
Supervisor repair after latest-head Codex review discovers required GitHub checks from job-level names or job IDs instead of workflow names.
Supervisor repair after latest-head Codex review rejects explicitly empty or malformed serve.compile.targets instead of applying upgrade defaults.
Supervisor repair after latest-head Codex review compiles only active accepted rules with explicit human_review/approved fields.
